creative_direction: Center an old-fashioned glass hand lantern whose interior has become a miniature birch grove. Replace the normal flame with warm light filtering between slender pale trunks and tiny moss-covered roots. The lantern frame is weathered brass, with a simple curved handle and clear panes that reveal the trees. Use a deep midnight-blue background and a small pool of amber light beneath the base. Render fine bark markings, tiny leaves, glass edge thickness, and modest brass wear, keeping the outer shape clean. The forest remains entirely within the lantern and contains no people or animals. Avoid magical sparkles; the impossible scale and natural light are enough to create wonder.
